fields.description: Supplier groups the Commercial Invoice and Proforma supplier pickers may offer, one group name per line (a JSON list is also accepted). Blank means no restriction: those pickers then list every supplier, as they did before this setting existed. Only the CI and Proforma pickers read it — the freight, truck and expense pickers stay unrestricted, because they legitimately need transporters and customs brokers.
fields.label: CI Supplier Groups

fields.description: Supplier groups whose bills may be hand-linked to a Commercial Invoice — transporters, customs brokers, service providers, one group name per line (a JSON list is also accepted). Blank means the hand-linking feature is OFF for this company: no bill is offered and none can be linked. Deliberately the inverse of CI Supplier Groups, which is a picker restriction where blank means no restriction; here blank means no permission, because this list is what stops an arbitrary payable from being attributed to an import.
fields.label: Transport / Service Supplier Groups (hand-linkable to a CI)
